title: Bound aggregate Multi-Site manual health probe concurrency

opportunity.rootCause: SiteHealthProbe was singleton-scoped but limited concurrency only inside each ProbeAsync call; simultaneous manual health requests could each create an HttpClient/handler and multiply total upstream work without a process-wide admission bound.
opportunity.scope: SiteHealthProbe manual health probe admission and default Waf:Sites configuration

implementation: Added a configurable global batch semaphore with a default of 16 concurrent Site probe batches and a hard configuration ceiling of 128.
Acquired the global gate before creating the per-batch handler/client and released it in a finally block on success, cancellation, or failure.
Preserved the existing maximum of 8 concurrent upstreams within each admitted Site batch and added the default configuration key HealthProbeMaxConcurrentBatches.

tddRed.reason: The new source contract initially failed because SiteHealthProbe had no MaxConcurrentBatches, WaitAsync gate, release, or configuration contract.

boundaries: Live loopback probe smoke is unavailable in this environment because socket creation returns AccessDenied in the existing probe tests
Live external upstream concurrency/latency benchmark and PostgreSQL persistence
